Magnusson 70 3/4" featheredge delivers reliable accuracy for construction tasks, plastering work and site finishing. The 1800mm aluminium blade keeps weight low while maintaining strength for consistent straightening and smoothing, and the 100mm blade width provides stable guidance. Features 1mm tapered, bevelled edge, offering controlled material removal across wide surfaces. Built entirely from aluminium, it withstands tough site conditions, and supports repeated daily use across professional building, renovation and drylining projects. Ideal for for smoothing and final finishing.
